question: Related Questions Q. I recently attended a wedding at at the end a few brothers were called to the stage to take photographs. A brother advised us that we should avoid posing for these photos but he did not give a reason as he was not 100% sure on the ruling. A few other brothers said they will only be saving these on their mobiles and not publishing them in anyway and some simply said there is nothing wrong and that the ruling was for something in the past about idol worshiping and that they will not be using to idol worship. Can you please advise on the correct ruling on this issue and please send me some hadith and Quran aayaats which help to convince everyone either way. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 645 Country: United States of America Title: Is it allowed for men to wear gold plated watches, which are not made of 100% gold? Question: Is it allowed for men to wear gold plated watches, which are not made of 100% gold? Answer ID: 645 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 596/J) Yes, men can wear gold plated watches, but not made of gold: واما التمویہ الذي لا یخ لص فلا باس بہ بالاجماع لانہ مستھلک فلا عبرة ببقائہ لونا اھ نقلہ في رد المحتار 9/497، کتاب الحظر والاباحة عن العینی وغیرہ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
